Water Based Coatings
When asked to consider Water Based coatings many people have a similar
response. They tried them once and they were too hard to use, slow to dry or gave a
milky appearance. Over the years, Milesi has developed Water Base coatings that have
matched the performance of North American conversion varnishes. Water Based
coatings are available as a 1 or 2 component product which are:
• Non-yellowing
• Dry crystal clear
• Easy clean up with water
• Very low in VOC’s
• Water, abrasion and chemical resistant
• Suitable for onsite finishing
• Greenguard Certified
In addition to these features, Water Based coatings are also Non-Flammable
which simplifies storage and decreases a potential fire hazard. Once dry, these coatings
are odorless and that can eliminate the solvent smell in your shop and your customers
home or office. Cleanup is simplified by using either warm water or a 50/50 mix of water
and isopropyl alcohol.
Columbia Industrial Supplies is here to supply you with all your Water Based finishing
requirements Including:
• Clear top coat in a variety of sheens
• Pigmented primer and top coat tintable to almost any colour
• Water based stain in either wipe on or spray-and-wipe application

Milesi’s clear and pigmented 2K Water based topcoats fall within all AWI system
standards and meet all KCMA cabinet finish requirements. More and more
homeowners, builders and architects are calling for low VOC, environmentally
conscious products. If you would like to know more about water based products, or
would like samples please give us a call
